evidenceProvenance.controller: OpenBlade.Capture working build immediately preceding commit 132fc01

action.name: Typed HyperBoost mode-7 reversible validation
action.value: Balanced mode 0 to HyperBoost mode 7 on both channels, then exact Balanced restoration with cooling pad present and Auto

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully: both mode-7 setters returned status-02 exact semantic echoes.
validation.readbackResult: Readback successful: channel 1 returned 01010700 and channel 2 returned 01020700.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully: both saved Balanced mode-0 setters returned status-02 exact semantic echoes.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Restoration readback successful: channel 1 returned 01010000 and channel 2 returned 01020000.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The mutation was gated to exact RZ09-0581, PID 02E0, BIOS 4.00, one exact laptop HID collection, one exact PID 0F43 report-ID-5 cooling-pad collection, inactive competing controllers, and inactive OpenBlade service.
The validator submitted one mode-7 write per channel, received both exact acknowledgements, and independently read mode 7/value 0 from both channels.
The validator restored the saved Balanced pair once, received both exact acknowledgements, and independently read the exact saved mode-0 state from both channels.

limitations: The laptop and cooling-pad preflights were separate ordered sessions; their multi-device correlation relies on the exact collections remaining attached throughout the bounded run and the operator-confirmed pad Auto state.

Synapse was force-terminated before preflight so its normal shutdown cleanup could not replace the operator-confirmed active Balanced baseline. Synapse and all stopped services were restored after validation.

The raw validator document contained a metadata-only legacy BIOS 3.01 constant inside its nested device object. The exact runtime gate, preflight, wrapper manifest, and host identity all confirmed BIOS 4.00; commit 132fc01 corrects future transcript metadata without repeating the hardware write.

This validates the exact pad-present mode-7 setter and paired readback/restoration contract. It does not validate pad-less activation, operation on another model or firmware, or behavior without the full-power adapter.
No power-limit telemetry, benchmark, sustained thermal load, or long-duration stability test was performed.
Raw transcripts, process inventory, and logs remain private and uncommitted.

productionAdmission.reason: The exact BIOS-4.00 pad-present mode-7 setter completed one acknowledged apply, paired semantic readback, exact saved-state restoration, and paired restoration readback. Pad-less use and cooling-pad fan writes remain separate gates.

notes: The validator refuses non-Balanced baselines and never retries an indeterminate write.
The cooling pad remained connected, powered, and operator-confirmed Auto throughout the mutation.
OpenBlade, Synapse, Razer Game Manager Service 3, and Razer Elevation Service were running after cleanup; USBPcap was not running.
